title: Endpoints, removable media, and remote access

items.question: May I use a personal USB stick to move a working file between two government PCs?
items.answer: Only if your departmental procedure allows that media for that classification. If it does not, use the approved transfer path. Unknown approval means do not use the stick.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: I am on a café wireless network. Can I open the departmental system if the page uses a password?
items.answer: Use the approved remote method. An open or unknown wireless network is not a safe channel for government information, even when the application itself asks for a password.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: Should I lock the screen when I step away from a meeting room?
items.answer: Yes. Clear screen applies even in a government building. Lock it every time you leave the seat.
